hero.headline: Find a Local Guide in Addis Ababa
hero.subheadline: Connect with experienced local guides who know Addis Ababa's history, culture, and hidden gems. Tell us what you're interested in and we'll match you with the right guide.

howItWorks.title: Tell Us Your Plans
howItWorks.description: Share your interests, preferred date, group size, and language needs.

howItWorks.title: We Match You
howItWorks.description: Our team reviews your request and matches you with a guide who fits your needs.

howItWorks.title: Confirm & Explore
howItWorks.description: Your guide contacts you directly to confirm details and share local insights.

form.headline: Request a Local Guide
form.subheadline: Fill out the form below and we'll match you with the right guide for your Addis Ababa visit.
form.disclosure: Guide availability, language capability, and final pricing are confirmed after we review your request.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book a guide?
faqs.answer: We recommend at least 48 hours notice for guide matching. For same-day requests, contact us via WhatsApp for availability.

faqs.question: What does a local guide cost?
faqs.answer: Guide fees depend on language, duration, and specialisation. We provide pricing after matching you with a guide.

faqs.question: Can guides accommodate special interests?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our guides specialise in history, culture, photography, food, coffee ceremonies, and more. Tell us your interests.

faqs.question: What if I need a guide for multiple days?
faqs.answer: Multi-day guide bookings are available. We can arrange a consistent guide for your entire Addis Ababa stay.
